description: 把输入、附件与思考模式，收进一个恰到好处的输入框。

提交后在原位显示输入内容
prompt:
请为我的项目实现「灵感输入框 / Prompt composer」组件。

目标
把输入、附件与思考模式，收进一个恰到好处的输入框。
请先依据项目已有框架、组件约定和设计变量实现，保留当前产品品牌，替换成真实业务内容。

布局与视觉
以温暖的浅灰背景承托白色界面，强调色 #4058F4。圆角 12–18px，1px 低对比边框与轻柔阴影；间距采用 8px 基础单位。主信息优先，辅助信息降低对比。正文 14–16px，中文行高 1.6，数字使用等宽数字。界面随容器宽度自然伸缩，不通过缩小整页适配手机。

必须实现的行为
1. 多行输入与空内容校验
2. 附件选择后显示文件名
3. 提交后在原位显示输入内容

交互与动效
按钮按下立即缩放到 0.97，约 160ms 恢复；状态切换使用 180–250ms 的减速过渡，大面板进入 300ms。状态立即更新，动画可以被连续操作打断。尊重 prefers-reduced-motion。悬停、按下、键盘焦点、选中和禁用必须可以区分。

边界与可访问性
使用语义化按钮、表单与 label，为纯图标提供可访问名称。支持 Tab 和 Enter，弹层支持 Escape 并恢复触发按钮焦点。空输入、长文案、连续操作和窄屏都要正确处理。错误时保留已有内容。不得伪造后端调用或支付成功。

验收
交付可以直接运行的实现，说明依赖与接入方式。在桌面与手机实际操作主要流程，检查 200% 缩放、减少动态设置、键盘访问和重复操作。将演示数据与真实业务接入点分开。

promptEn:
Build “Prompt composer” as a production-ready UI component in my existing project.

A focused composer for ideas, attachments, and reasoning.

REQUIRED BEHAVIOR
1. Multiline input with empty validation
2. Show selected attachment name
3. Submit to an inline, local response

VISUAL DIRECTION
Use a calm, light interface: white surfaces, warm neutral page backgrounds, subtle 1px borders, 12–18px corner radii, and clear type hierarchy. Use a restrained blue accent, an 8px spacing rhythm, 14–16px body text, and tabular numerals for data. Avoid decorative clutter and tiny unreadable labels.

RESPONSIVE REQUIREMENTS
Support mobile at 390px, tablet at 768px, and desktop at 1440px. On mobile, use a single main content column and accessible navigation/context drawers. On tablet, keep the primary navigation and collapse secondary context. On desktop, show the full layout. Never shrink the whole app to simulate responsiveness; reflow the actual content.

IMPLEMENTATION

Reuse existing project styles and components; otherwise keep styles self-contained and namespaced. The supplied source should be runnable without a model API. Expose explicit integration points for model calls, persistent data, navigation, and file storage. Do not fake production calls, payments, uploads, or approvals.

STATES, ACCESSIBILITY, AND MOTION
Handle empty input, long content, loading, errors, disabled states, and repeated actions. Use semantic controls, visible focus, meaningful labels, Escape dismissal, and sensible focus return. Use 160–250ms transitions and immediate feedback; honor reduced motion. Clean up timers, listeners, and network requests on unmount.

DELIVERY AND ACCEPTANCE
Provide the complete source, setup steps, dependencies, and integration boundaries. Verify the primary interactions on mobile, tablet, and desktop, plus keyboard navigation, 200% zoom, long text, and reduced motion. State which data is local and where a real service must be connected.

Deliver a runnable React / Next.js client component, Vue 3 component or standalone HTML file. Namespace styles and avoid extra UI, font or CDN dependencies. Verify repeated actions, long text, terminal disabled states, reset, keyboard access and 200% zoom. Mark the real service integration points and preserve public reference links.
